prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
engine_stated_criteria: all relevant plans in your state
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong place to start for individual or family coverage in the Kansas City area. It describes itself as an independent brokerage, says its producers are licensed in both Missouri and Kansas, and reports a 5.0 Google rating across 90 reviews. It says it compares Marketplace and other plans and can check your doctors and subsidy eligibility.

**Contact:** (816) 205-4664 · [bbs-insurance.com](https://bbs-insurance.com/)

Another option is **AIS Health Advisors** in Overland Park, which says it helps individuals and families compare ACA Marketplace plans and check subsidy eligibility: [aishealthadvisors.com](https://aishealthadvisors.com/).

Before enrolling, ask whether the broker can compare **all relevant plans in your state**, whether they charge you a fee, and whether your doctors, prescriptions, and preferred hospitals are in-network. Your home address determines whether you shop Missouri or Kansas plans.
